description: uinaf shared Renovate policy: daily, seven-day release age, patch and minor grouped, digest pinning.

packageRules.description: First-party reusable workflows track main by design; bumps land once in uinaf/.github
Group patch and minor updates per manager; majors stay separate
Runtime versions move as one PR across managers: the .python-version or node-version pin, the requires-python range, and the image tag fail checks when any one of them moves alone
Digest moves stay manual and get their own group so they never hold an automergeable patch or minor PR

Renovate merges grouped patch, minor, and pin updates itself after every visible check passes; repositories without checks and all majors stay manual. Digest-only updates carry no release timestamps, so the seven-day age gate cannot apply; they stay manual
GitHub Actions use the ci commit prefix
OpenTofu registry for providers and modules
required_version tracks OpenTofu releases, not Terraform

Container images track upstream on a one-day gate: they are digest-pinned and every bump passes repository checks before it merges, so the seven-day window mostly holds back fixes on daily-shipping images
Actions are pinned to a commit digest, so the release age adds no assurance the digest does not already give
Pin Actions and images by digest on the initial run without waiting for release age
